sessionHeader: SYNTHETIC SESSION. Fictional client c01 (Ananya R.), session 2026-11-19. Not a real person.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: How have the last two weeks been?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Good, actually. I did the two-line update. Twice.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Twice! How was it?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: First time my hands were shaking. Second time it was fine. Someone even asked me a follow-up question.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: How did you handle the question?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I answered it. Badly, I thought, but my teammate said it was clear.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: How anxious before and after?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Five before, two after.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That's the lowest yet. And sleep?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Notifications off every night. Asleep in about 30 minutes most nights.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That was your original goal.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I know. It feels strange to say it's working.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Let's let it be strange for a bit. What's next on the list?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Presenting a full slide at the monthly review. In December.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Would you like to prepare for that together next time?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes. Maybe practise in session.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Bring a draft slide and we'll practise. Keep the sleep log, it's how we know this is holding.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Next session the 3rd of December?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes, evening.
